name: Mary's Daughter
summary: Mad Mary's daughter Gertruda, sixteen and never once allowed outside, slipped out of the house a few nights ago and hasn't come back.

stages.journal: Behind the barred door of a townhouse near the main road, Mad Mary weeps for her daughter Gertruda, who went out at night and never came home.
We promised Mary we'd look for Gertruda. She's sixteen, dark-haired, and has never seen the valley she's lost in.
We told Mary we couldn't look for her daughter. Her weeping followed us all the way down the lane.
Gertruda's window latch was opened from the inside, and she took her good shoes. Nobody carried her off. She went out to meet someone.
